question: Point out the correct answer regarding whooping cough:

options.opa: It is not very contagious, with attack rates below 20% in susceptible people.
options.opb: It is a frequent cause of prolonged cough in adolescents and adults.
options.opc: Individuals vaccinated and those who have passed the disease acquire permanent immunity.
options.opd: Children under two years of age with suspected pertussis require hospital admission due to the risk of complications.
